Definition: properly, to cut, i.e. damage; also to grow (causatively, make) poor
BiblicalUsage: çâkan means to cut and damage, or to make poor. It appears twice, in Ecclesiastes among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâkan, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
